lore_anchors.definition: An insidious energy lock planted by a superior cultivator, triggerable to cause excruciating pain and other harmful effects; a constant, living leash used for control.
A lost treasure crafted from demon beast materials, capable of incredible speed when powered by special lightning-attributed energy, but at a high energy cost.
A disguise technique that alters a cultivator’s physical appearance and body shape; can be dispelled by violent spiritual energy disruptions.
A magic weapon or artifact from a lost prehistoric era, typically far more powerful than modern equivalents and often lacking modern convenience features like body absorption.
